column1: # RECIPE_MEMORY.tsv - append-only lesson memory of recipe lint-storage-20261107 (RELOCATE_LINT_STORAGE): one row per lesson, appended in the same commit as the correction.

column4: the crate's PackedIntArray and VInt share simple names with the module's jdk.m3.arrays.packed owners but come from another lineage (IntWidth-parameterized 32..64-bit signed/unsigned storage with ProgressMonitor-staged bulk operations and a slot-based varint codec, against a sealed Int40/48/56 storage and a fresh-array varint codec); equivalence is not decided, so both are NEC and every class whose closure needs them (AdaptiveIntArray, PackedIntNative and the C kernel, their tests) is held with them; only IntWidth, Lint and LintTest have a closure free of the NEC rows

column4: the crate postimages of IntWidth, Lint and LintTest are the same blobs as the synexia-common main paths (one writing commit 4a2e6452a7a, 2026-10-31), so the FILE rows read the main paths and the postimages are OMIT rows; PackedIntArray is the exception (main 539850f1179f with a VarHandle word read, crate 8007d1a4c059 with the byte loop), recorded in its NEC row

column4: LintTest reaches one helper of the held PackedIntArrayTest (randomValue); a TYPE row maps the class to the authored test-scope reference class M3LintStorageReference, which carries the same three-line BigInteger helper, so the relocated test draws the same values without relocating the NEC test; the crate test run on both sides proves it (identical JUnit trees)
